slides.title: Prosody for rhetorical effect
slides.subtitle: Using voice to persuade
goals: Use pausing, pace and pitch strategically.

slides.title: Techniques
list: **Slow down** for emphasis; speed up for lists.
**Drop pitch** at the end of strong statements.
Rule of three with rising-rising-falling tone.

items.en: We will not stop. We will not rest. We will not give up.
This is not the end. It is the beginning.
